insert into ai_token_usage (user_id, service_name, profile, model_name,input_tokens,output_tokens,total_tokens, occurred_at) values
(#{it.userId}, #{it.serviceName}, #{it.profile}, #{it.modelName}, #{it.inputTokens}, #{it.outputTokens}, #{it.totalTokens}, #{it.occurredAt})
mapper.select: select user_id, sum(input_tokens) as input_tokens, sum(output_tokens) as output_tokens, sum(total_tokens) as total_tokens, count(*) as request_count from ai_token_usage where occurred_at >= #{start} and occurred_at < #{end} group by user_id
